sloka: किं मामसदृशं वाक्यमीदृशं श्रोत्रदारुणम् ।रूक्षं श्रावयसे वीर प्राकृतः प्राकृतामिव ।। ६.११९.५ ।।
transliteration: kiṁ māmasadṛśaṁ vākyamīdṛśaṁ śrotradāruṇam ।rūkṣaṁ śrāvayase vīra prākṛtaḥ prākṛtāmiva ।। 6.119.5 ।।

translations.english: "Hero! Why are you addressing me in such harsh unkind words in a rude manner, in a harsh tone like a common man?"
